name: search_content
description: Search live paragraph/table w:t text; returns [{id,preview}] node hits for anchors/targets. Use scope:"comments" or scope:"all" to search comment text; the default scope is body. At most 50 matches come back; truncated:true says more exist. A table hit also lists `cells` (up to 5 addresses such as t_001:r3c1) for the cells that hold the match; pass one as the target of replace/style/namedStyle/clearFormat/hyperlink/bookmark/comment. Chart titles/series are NOT matched by search (they live in the chart part, not w:t); discover them in inspect TOON chart rows, then anchor by the chart node id. Image alt text and footnote/endnote bodies are NOT matched either (search covers body w:t text only); find images via inspect [IMG] rows and footnotes via their anchor ids. Search extension to those parts is a later-program candidate, not this surface. Default is an exact literal substring (case-insensitive); pass {"regex":true} to interpret the query as a regular expression (bounded: pattern <=200 chars, ~500ms evaluation budget, case-insensitive). Caps: first 50 hits, 120-char previews. Literal queries containing regex metacharacters return literal results plus a hint that regex:true exists. Example {"sessionId":"sess_abc","query":"Executive Summary"} -> {"ok":true,"matches":[{"id":"3F2A9C1B","preview":"Executive ..."}]}. Search before editing when the anchor id is unknown.
